Consent.title: AI helps, but you should always verify!
Consent.content1: Poll-E chatbot uses AI to generate responses based on official public documents from political parties but they may not always be accurate.
Consent.content2: We recommend verifying information from official sources.
Consent.Continue: I acknowledge that. Let me try!

Quiz.title: Which party matches your views?
Quiz.intro: Answer 30 statements from the 2025 election programs. At the end you'll see how closely your answers match each party's manifesto.
Quiz.results-explanation: How closely your answers match each party's manifesto. Statements a manifesto doesn't address are left out for that party.
Quiz.results-disclaimer: This is not a voting recommendation. Positions were derived from the manifestos with AI help and reviewed by hand; the parties did not answer the statements themselves.
Quiz.disclaimer: Based on the parties' manifestos, may contain mistakes
Quiz.generic-error: Something went wrong loading the quiz. Please try again.
